models_evaluated: Dr.Knows (LLM with medical knowledge graph retrieval-augmented generation)

links.outcome: Diagnosis prediction and rationale quality when LLMs are grounded in a medical knowledge graph via RAG
links.effect: Abstract reports no numeric results; it describes both challenges and opportunities in using external knowledge graph grounding for diagnosis prediction.
links.quote: Using real-world hospital datasets, our study serves to enrich the discourse on the role of medical KGs in grounding medical knowledge into LLMs, revealing both challenges and opportunities in harnessing external knowledge for explainable diagnostic pathway and the realization of AI-augmented diagnostic decision support systems.

unlisted_practices: Selecting relevant knowledge-graph pathology paths based on problem descriptions to ground LLM diagnosis prediction
Comprehensive human evaluation of LLM diagnosis predictions and their rationales

screen.reason: Evaluates using medical knowledge graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to ground LLMs for diagnostic prediction and diagnostic safety using EHR datasets and human evaluation.
